risk_flags.message: USDe: Custody data in use is the July 2026 attestation, 55d old (threshold 45d); latest published (custodian-attestations-of-assets-backing-usde-august-3) is 14d old

USDe: A newer attestation (custodian-attestations-of-assets-backing-usde-august-3) is published than the embedded snapshot (custodian-attestations-of-assets-backing-usde-july-3) — re-derive the per-custodian breakdown AND the disclosed wallet roster. A matching wallet set is NOT sufficient to clear this: custody composition moves while the addresses stay put

backing.basis: Anchored on this analyzer's own flags: COVERAGE_WARN 1.0 (par) -> 4/5, COVERAGE_CRIT 0.98 -> 2/5, and par + COVERAGE_DRIFT_PP (2.0pp) -> 5/5. A delta-neutral synthetic targets par, not 130%, so the generic scale rates its design state 3/5 'Watch'. A WARN below par can no longer coexist with a 4/5.
backing.expires_reason: Par and two flag thresholds; none drifts.

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($2,000,000) still clears inside 200bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '2% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.
liquidity.scope: Routed across every venue kyberswap reaches on ethereum, selling into USDC. ⚠️ ONE CHAIN — depth on other chains is not included and is not implied to be zero.

exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.

liquidity.note: Primary exit: 7-day cooldown to USDe at NAV; ladder = instant secondary market.

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: sUSDe is a wrapper over USDe, so its backing ratio is USDe's coverage including the reserve fund — a claim on USDe is worth what USDe is backed by. ⚠️ NOT the share-to-USDe relationship, which is 1:1 by construction and published separately as usde_backing_per_share_pct: rating that would be rating a definition. See ?asset=usde for what stands behind the number.
backing.usde_backing_per_share_note: Definitional: every sUSDe share is a claim on staked USDe, so this is 100% by construction and carries no information about backing.
